post_text:
Day 12/30 — HybridCache (.NET & C#)

Manual two-tier caching between memory and Redis usually breeds race conditions and stampedes during cache expiry.

• **Cache Stampede:** Built-in coordination locks prevent concurrent database hits for the same missing key.
• **Serialization:** Offloads expensive JSON serialization directly to L2 while keeping L1 binary or object-based.
• **Tag Eviction:** Clears related L1/L2 cache entries instantly via invalidation tags without manual key tracking.

Watch out: L1 memory pressure can spike if you cache large graphs without size limits.

Are you still rolling your own memory plus Redis wrappers?
